children: 22nd Century Group filed a prospectus supplement permitting sales of up to 18.8 million shares through its at-the-market offering.
The October 23 supplement covers sales under the company’s Sales Agreement with Needham & Company.
In October, the company sold 15,785,757 shares under the agreement, generating approximately $4.7 million in gross proceeds.
As of October 23, 2026, 19,202,198 common shares were outstanding.
